newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end firm, but still stuck eyeing CPI.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end firm, but still stuck eyeing CPI.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed firmer on Wednesday, helped by a good start on Wall Street but stuck in the same trading range ahead of January inflation data tomorrow, dealer said.
The general index added 1.77 points, 0.37 percent, to 475.01 and the Ibex rose 16.17 points, 0.3 percent to 5,435.37.
Some stocks were helped by an outperform recommendation by Salomon Bros, dealers said. Santander added 60 pesetas to 9,060 and Acerinox rose 190 pesetas to 18,750.
January inflation is seen at 3.0 percent year on year. Below that rate could fuel expectations of a rate cut Friday, while 3.1 percent would send the bourse sharply lower, dealers said.

"If the CPI is in line with analyst expectations, it's unlikely the Bank of Spain will cut rates and we'll stay stuck in the same range between (Ibex) resistance at 5,450 and support at 5,211," said one dealer.
But they added the bourse still might need more news to shift it out of the current narrow trading corridor.
